BiblicalUsage: A pruning knife is the tool that turns a sword into a farming blade, and the prophets use it for the age of peace: they shall beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Joel turns the picture around for the day of war: beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into spears.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two pictures belong together: God will one day make the tools of war into tools of peace, and until that day the nations will keep turning the tools of peace into weapons, but the pruning hook is the promise that the war will end.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
